headline: Software Engineer | Applied AI & Intelligent Systems
intro: I build software from architecture and backend services to user interfaces and deployment. My work spans enterprise applications, applied machine learning, and embedded systems.
availability: Available for a final-year engineering internship from March 15 through September 2027.
about: I’m an ESI Algiers graduate and a Master’s student at UPEC, specializing in AI, data science, and cyber-physical systems.

lib.title: National Library Information System
lib.summary: At Spintechs, I designed Spring Boot REST APIs and domain models for readers, staff, and guests. I built registration workflows, React back-office interfaces, and reader portal features, including multilingual and right-to-left layouts.

wind.title: Wind Turbine Predictive Maintenance
wind.summary: Our two-person team combined SCADA fault classification and power forecasting. I designed the software architecture, built the dashboard and simulator, and worked on time-series analysis, MQTT integration, and Jetson Nano setup.
wind.note: The evaluation needs further auditing to assess possible data leakage and generalization.

qube.title: QubeLink — IoT Smart Plug
qube.summary: Our team built a smart plug controlled from a mobile app. I designed the circuit and enclosure, developed ESP8266 firmware with Wi-Fi and MQTT, and implemented the app’s connection functionality.

gait.title: Personalized Gait Phase Estimation
gait.summary: At UPEC, I’m exploring how wearable sensor data can be used to estimate gait phases and how these methods can adapt to different individuals.

brace.title: BracePy — Compiler Front End
brace.summary: A front end for a custom language, covering lexical, syntactic, and semantic analysis and intermediate-code generation.

shop.title: Annassib — E-commerce Platform
shop.summary: A responsive online store with product filtering, checkout, and an administration interface for managing products and orders.

att.title: Student Attendance App
att.summary: A mobile attendance-tracking application I worked on during my internship at Yahia Fares University.

spintechs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer · Spintechs
spintechs.summary: Own full-stack features across library administration and reader services, from business rules to reusable interfaces. Document APIs, test workflows, and support integration.

clients.karbal: Karbal Law Firm · {{dates}}. Fixed frontend issues, built new layouts in CodeIgniter, and deployed production updates.
clients.annassib: Annassib · {{dates}}. Built and deployed an e-commerce platform with checkout, role-based access, and an administration panel.

cder.title: AI & Software Engineering Graduation Project · CDER
cder.summary: Worked in a two-person team on wind turbine predictive maintenance, contributing to model experimentation, system integration, and technical documentation.

mobile.title: Mobile Development Intern · Yahia Fares University
mobile.summary: Worked on a student attendance app using {{technologies}}.

upec.degree: Master 2 in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Cyber-Physical Systems (IA2S)

esi.degree: State Engineering Degree in Computer Science and Master’s in Computer Systems and Software
